history.label: History
notes: Faster, no page text: visits from eCW's Angular data; CPT/E&M codes in batches of 25; diagnoses per visit (6 at a time); insurance from each visit's claim — first only for the visits the rules need (same year / last 60 days), the rest in the background. No note reading, no merging.

sort.label: Smart Sort
notes: Removes an SL modifier when the patient is 18 or older (keeps it under 18)

coding.label: Coding
notes: Works with History 2.0 (rules refresh when background insurance arrives); the 30-day gap checks now use the visit date on the schedule too
Schedule mode: patient list shows each visit's status; schedule dots repainted only when something changed

Schedule mode: Add to EMR from the schedule — added/removed codes (incl. CPT removals and office-visit swaps), order, primary, modifiers (Smart Sort) and pointers (Link) in one save, then read back and checked
Schedule mode: patient list docked beside the panel (time, name, type, colored dot) — click a patient to open it; 'hide list' / 'show list' in the panel header
Dots on the schedule rows for visits you've looked at (amber = changes, green = none, grey = locked)
